shadow.title: Shadow libraries
shadow.lede: Sites that copy books and papers without the rights holder's permission. A web result on one of them is never shown, and the Scout never proposes it. A name blocks every site whose host has it as one part before the last: libgen blocks libgen.rs, libgen.is and all their subdomains. The search on this host follows your change at once, the public site within 30 seconds.

targets.title: Known vendors, services and tools
targets.lede: Names a relationship may point at without a catalog resource. A vendor is a company. A service is what a resource connects to, such as Slack or GitHub. A tool is an application a resource runs in or plugs into, such as VS Code or Claude Desktop. Where a resource runs (Python, the command line) is a platform, not a target. The next Scout run confirms the waiting relationships that name what you add.

enrichment.title: Enrichment queue

lede.WAITING: What the Scout enriches next, in its order: the ones you moved to the top first, then never-run resources, then the ones to try again; inside each part, the most popular first (stars or downloads), then the newest. An action changes the order only: the daily enrichment limit stays the same.
lede.SKIPPED: The resources you skipped, the latest first. The Scout does not take them until you requeue them.
lede.OUT_OF_RETRIES: The resources whose runs failed too many times. The Scout does not try them again until you requeue them.

aiCheck.title: Not about AI by the word rule
aiCheck.lede: Reads the catalog from the most popular resource down and lists the ones whose title, description and tags do not say they are about AI. A resource found by a source that only holds AI (Hugging Face, arXiv, the MCP Registry, the AI news feeds, the discovery collectors) is never listed. Nothing changes until you act: look at each one, and skip a waiting one to keep it out of the enrichment queue.
